reviews.text: Every time I take Leila for an emergency visit or anual check up always get a good service from the clinic. The doctor always clear all my doubts and gives the best care to my cat.

I think they provide terrible service and it's very expensive. They don't do any tests or anything on your pet in your presence, which is awful. You don't know what they do to them in the clinic where they take them, or if they actually do what they claim. They're not friendly. They were supposed to give me the results of some skin tests they did on my cats, and they never did. I've called three times, and no one has given me any answers. They said they would call me back, but they never did. I just hope my cats get better with the medication; otherwise, I'll have wasted over $800 I paid. Terrible service, and I would never go back there. Disappointed 😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡
My almost 3 month old kitten was sick, and they gave me so much reassurance and kindness that they relieved my stress. The staff are so friendly and welcoming. Very budget friendly.
This was my kitten first time at a vet. She did amazing ,and the staff made sure she was very comfortable.
First time for  Benji! They are so welcoming and very friendly and super clean!
Friendly staff & willing to answer questions

Wonderful experience! I called and they scheduled my self and Akan for the very next day. I arrived a few minutes early and they took us immediately. No wait “until it’s your turn”. This was my first time coming to this vet. I brought my baby here for his first shots preparing him for good health. The staff were friendly and liked my kitty on site. Gave him lots of love and compliments. Dr. Patel was very warm and my kitty liked him. Will be back in two weeks.
Great and quick , vet was great

Had a small scare with one of my two cats the other day and brought him in to Queens Animal Hospital. I was very stressed out and nervous (as I’m sure most people are when they have a pet issue). The reception desk got us checking in immediately and were very friendly, professional and helpful.

Dr. Arias and the entire staff working that day gave my cat great care and I left feeling legitimately relieved.

What really made this a 5 star experience besides the top notch care was the phone call I got from Dr. Arias breaking down my cat’s test results. I felt I got more details and a proper explanation from Dr Arias than I would my own doctor.

I will be bringing our second cat for a check up and absolutely recommend them
Our cat felt super calm and confident with Dr. David Arias
